pages.text: Rain, snow and storms take away grip: a car is slower to get going, takes longer to stop, and slides wide in hard turns.$(br)$(li)Rain: 80% grip$(li)Thunderstorm: 65%$(li)Snow: 55%$(li)Ice: like glass$(br2)The dashboard shows WET, STORM, SNOW or ICE.
Wipers sweep the windshield in rain and snow; water sprays up behind the wheels.
Snow covers parked cars, and blows off once they're driven.

Lightning sometimes strikes a car in a storm, but the people inside are safe.$(br2)$(item)Winter Tires$(), fitted at a $(l:tuning/tuning)Tuning Bench$(/l), win back most of the grip on snow and ice and half of it in the rain. Headlights come on by themselves in bad weather.
